summary: America Movil filed a 6-K announcing it will acquire 100% of WOW Peru via its subsidiary America Movil Peru S.A.C. from Liberty Latin America and Narvik Capital Partners. Terms (price, premium, implied value) are not disclosed. The board's recommendation is not addressed. The transaction is structured as a share purchase, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approval from INDECOPI. No advisor, break fee, or timeline is mentioned. Watch for INDECOPI's antitrust review and any subsequent disclosures; the risk-arb spread cannot be calculated absent price terms.
